reviews.text: We recently had our pool, spa, and outdoor fireplace built here in Westlake, and the whole experience was fantastic. Grant was our designer—he really listened to what we wanted and offered helpful suggestions based on his experience. He made adjustments whenever we asked and came up with creative ideas that made the design even better. William was our project supervisor. He checked in with us almost every day, making sure the site was always tidy and that we were happy with how everything was coming along. He was always quick to answer any questions and took care of anything we brought up right away. It was clear that the same contractors work together on different jobs, so everyone knew exactly how things should be done and the whole process ran smoothly. Now that we've enjoyed our new pool for a couple of months, we can say it looks amazing. Friends and family have given us so many compliments. We love the in-floor cleaners—they keep the pool sparkling clean with hardly any effort on our part. A couple of small things came up after the pool was finished, but the team responded quickly and handled everything without any hassle. The entire build was done in about nine weeks, which was much faster than I expected. Overall, we are extremely pleased and would definitely recommend this pool service company to anyone in Westlake looking for quality pool construction and great customer care.
reviews.author: leslie molina

reviews.text: I really appreciate this pool service. They show up right on schedule every week, and I get helpful text updates with my pool service report after each visit. When I needed repairs, their maintenance team was quick and did a great job replacing my old filter with a more efficient one. My pool has stayed crystal clear and algae-free all summer, which has never happened before! I have an older fiberglass pool and couldn’t be happier with how it’s been taken care of. Highly recommend their services if you want to keep your pool looking great, especially during the hot Texas months.
reviews.author: Naomi H

reviews.text: Select Trophy Club Pool Service did an outstanding job with the design and construction of our pool in Westlake. We wanted a lap pool with a spa, and Brandon came up with the perfect plan that made great use of our backyard space. The design process was smooth and straightforward. Even though we had some rainy days, the crew made sure to work whenever the weather allowed, and they finished our pool much quicker than we expected. The team kept the work area tidy at all times, which we really appreciated. They even provided a porta potty for the crew, showing attention to details that matter to homeowners. William handled the tile and block work and did an excellent job. David took care of all the plumbing and electrical, and he was always easy to communicate with. The project was always closely managed to make sure everything stayed on track and any questions we had were addressed right away. Now, our pool looks fantastic and works perfectly. We’re very happy with how everything turned out and would definitely recommend this company to anyone looking for pool service in the area.
reviews.author: Katrina Tucker

reviews.text: i recently hired Select Trophy Club Pool Service for some much-needed pool repairs and cleaning, and i couldn't be happier with the results. william and his team took care of everything from start to finish. first, they drained my pool and spa, then used a glass beading cleaning method to get rid of all the calcium deposits along the water line. the tiles look like they were just installed. our white plaster had some ugly stains and discoloration, but after an acid wash, it looks so bright and clean—almost need sunglasses to look at it! they also removed the old seal around the pool, cleaned it up, and got it ready for new deck-O seal between the deck and coping. the finish looks perfect now. the most important thing for me was updating the pool and spa lights. the old lights and cables were really stuck, and another company couldn't even get them out, but william figured it out and installed brand new LED lights with seven different light shows. they look amazing at night! on top of all that, they took apart the pool filter, cleaned all the grids, balanced the water chemistry, and made sure everything was just right. the price was much better than other companies i called, and the service was top notch. if you need any kind of pool service or repair, i highly recommend giving them a call!
reviews.author: Jordan Mercado

reviews.text: select trophy club pool service is the best choice for getting your pool cleaned or brought up to date. everyone was professional and treated us with respect. we had grant and tanner take care of everything, from cleaning out problem areas to making sure the pool tile looked great. they handled a lot more than just the basics, and got the pool perfectly ready for the next steps. the whole team worked together smoothly, like a well oiled machine. later, david stopped by to double-check everything, but there was nothing left to fix. i would recommend this company to anyone in westlake who wants their pool cleaned or refreshed.
reviews.author: B Dillon

reviews.text: I recently noticed my pool heater was leaking, so I called Select Trophy Club Pool Service. Right away, I spoke to a real person, and William was quick to help with my problem. He offered helpful advice and set up a repair visit within just a couple of days. He also took the time to explain all my options clearly, which made me feel confident in my choice. A few days later, Brandon reached out to let me know there was a small issue with my credit card information. We sorted it out quickly—just a minor number error, and he was very polite about it. I've used this pool cleaning company for years, and it's obvious they really care about their customers. Their team is always friendly and ready to help, which is hard to find these days. If you need any help with your pool heater or cleaning services, this is definitely the company to call!
reviews.author: Wyatt Bond

reviews.text: I had a great experience with my pool cleaning and repair service in Westlake. My pool was leaking in several spots, but William did a fantastic job finding the main issue. He set up the skimmer in a way that let him easily check the water level without risking damage to the pump. Thanks to this, he was able to pinpoint the crack causing the problem. William took care of the repairs, removed and replaced only the necessary tiles (unlike other companies that told me the whole edge tile had to go), and then cleaned up the pool until it looked sparkling and new. The whole process was smooth, and the price was much better than other quotes I received. I’ll definitely call them again when it’s time to resurface my pool!
reviews.author: sonia sloan

reviews.text: we hired this company to redo our pool deck with new pavers, install step stones, and set up a dog run using artificial turf. the final look is beautiful and really transforms our backyard. grant and tanner did a great job with the paver layout and coping work, showing a lot of attention to detail. there were some early communication mix-ups about the artificial grass and square footage, but the team handled it professionally and made sure everything was sorted out. the crew worked around my tight schedule since i had other vendors on site, and they coordinated things well. even though there were some small hiccups along the way, the company was responsive and made adjustments where needed. now, our pool area looks fantastic and we’re very happy with the results.
reviews.author: Julianna Miller
